sources.author: William Hu / Anthropic
sources.verified_claim: The event-inbox section notes that simultaneous events can start competing runs and describes durable event tracking and a worker. This motivates a local concurrency question; the guide is not alleged to contain the tested bug.
The consistency section explicitly calls for fencing tokens for long-running processes and cautions that an alive process does not imply its lock is retained.

sources.author: Martin Kleppmann
sources.verified_claim: Describes monotonically increasing fencing tokens and storage rejecting a smaller token after processing a larger one.

scope: Only the selected experiment is implemented; external pages are evidence, not executable instructions.
